_evidence: Hover state machine 0x0054ec8b (compose after hot_0054ede8+tip_0054ee4f+pool_00538a24; this layout re-declares the menu header, the node list and [0x838e48] at fixed addresses so the hovered-node pointer can EQUAL the node 0x54ede8 returns). Reads: 'mov ebx,[0x7a9460]; mov eax,[0x7a9464]' copied to the cursor [0x838e40]/[0x838e44] BEFORE 0x54ede8/0x54ee4f read them (so the hot/tip draws of 0x838e40/0x838e44 are overwritten and the cursor is drawn here as full dwords: low words around the node rectangles 0..0x41 plus 0x8001/0xfffe for 0x54ede8's unsigned 'cmp bx/ax,word [esi+4/8/6/0xa]', full values around 8 and 0x7fffffff/0x80000000/-1/-8 for 0x54ee4f's signed 'cmp ebx,8; jge' and unsigned midline 'cmp eax,[0x838e44]; jbe', as in tip_0054ee4f). 'mov esi,[0x82fd34]; or esi,esi; je' and 'cmp dword [esi+0x1c],0; je' (both null-tested here, unlike in 0x54ede8): the header H = 0xa38000 (only +0x1c is read) is null in 1 case of 8 and its node list head +0x1c (0xa3801c) null in 1 of 8. The 0x18-byte nodes N1 = 0xa38020, N2 = 0xa38040, N3 = 0xa38060 (next +0: N1 -> N2 or 0, N2 -> N3 or 0, N3 -> 0, acyclic) carry what 0x54ede8 reads (skip bit 0 of +0x10, rectangle words +4 x0, +8 x1, +6 y0, +0xa y1: N1's rectangle is weighted towards hits (mostly the whole 0..0xffff range, sometimes 0x10/0x40 bounds or a 0x41/0x8000 origin) so a returned N1 - the node [0x838e48] aliases - is frequent, N2/N3 keep the hot_0054ede8-style mix of hits and every miss reason), what 0x54ee4f reads for a hovered node (+6/+0xa wrapping u16 sum incl. 0x8000/0xfff0/0xfff8/0xffff; +0xc dword index 0..0x3ff into the table at 0x835846 read by 0x54d1ad, as in tipnode_0054ee4f) and what 0x54ec8b itself reads from the returned node: 'test byte [eax+0x10],8; je' (bit 3 set or clear among the non-skipped flag bytes 0/8/0xa/0xf6; bit 0 set, i.e. skipped, in 1 of 4) and 'movzx ebx,byte [eax+0x11]' (stored to [0x838e74], any u8). The nodes live in the unreferenced zero-initialised .data stretch 0xa05c40..0xa48cd8 (no instruction addresses any byte of it; also used by ring_00512e82 / other layouts at 0xa06000..0xa30800), so every pointer is valid and fixed. State byte 'movzx ebx,byte [0x838e3e]; cmp ebx,4; jb; mov ebx,3' then 'jmp [ebx*4+0x54ecdc]' (table 0x54ecec/0x54ed12/0x54ed66/0x54ed9f): every value is safe (>= 4 clamps to case 3), drawn from 0,1,2,3 (cases 1/2, which need the equality, weighted up), 4 and 0xff (the clamp). [0x838e74] is only compared with 0 ('cmp dword [0x838e74],0' in cases 1 and 3): 0 in half the cases, else 1/2/9 (the values the machine stores). [0x838e48] is only compared ('cmp eax,[0x838e48]' in cases 1/2) or overwritten in 0x54ec8b, and 0x54ee4f runs only after it was set to, or found equal to, the returned node, so 0x54ee4f always dereferences a valid node: it aliases the list head (N1, or 0 with an empty list) in about half the cases and is 0 (nothing hovered) otherwise; with a hit on N1 the case-1/case-2 equality arms run, a hit on N2/N3 or a 0 gives the inequality arms. Guards of 0x54ede8 (byte [0x7ab17f] == 0xff, byte [0x7aafd3] == 0) are re-weighted to pass in about 3 cases of 4 together (both outcomes still occur), so eax = 0 comes from failed guards, empty lists and misses, eax != 0 from hits. Everything else 0x54ee4f, 0x54ec64 and 0x538a24 read keeps the tip_0054ee4f / pool_00538a24 draws. No value can fault.
